native_contract_seams.body_profile: Locally source-fixed ReviewedBodyProfileV01; no wire-selected import or executable selector.
native_contract_seams.signed_integrity_scope: check_pointer/check_bundle and public Root signer verification, with independent peer key anchors.
native_contract_seams.status: ImportStore.observe authenticates and persists terminal observations before current-use refusal; check_status requires ACTIVE with request/nonce binding.
native_contract_seams.source_revision: Status highwater is per pointer/stream, not a global highest source revision. Current revision policy or persisted terminal old-pointer disposition must prevent rollback.
native_contract_seams.disclosure: PublisherBudget.reserve and disclosure precede body construction/send; denied attempts are distinct from disclosed-body counters.
native_contract_seams.local_consumption: Foreign signature and ACCEPT remain evidence. Recipient derives a fresh local Root/Host context and actual typed Work input/output; source and current status are rechecked at use.

concrete_adapter_constraints: Calibration Requester/publisher convenience paths contain fixed calibration contexts and body fields; they cannot simply be renamed as support-document integration.
ImportStore.validate_bundle does not forward a body profile; a custom body profile needs an explicit source-reviewed call to check_bundle(profile=...).
The generic adaptation contract remains correction/offset-specific. A different domain needs its own reviewed typed Work input binding.
gate5_native.native_work declares controlled donor clock1014. The positive owner path must use real current native prerequisites, not relabel this control as real-time authority.
Request and status validity are bounded to60seconds; fresh bases should be acquired close to actual consumption without TTL extension.
Incorrect issuer/scope, expiry and rollback controls must reach their intended guards rather than fail earlier for unrelated stale request metadata.
architecture_conditions: Two real isolated processes with separate Root/state/signing capabilities; trusted public-key bootstrap outside incoming body.
Ordinary native-only entry before PlanAuth retains explicit admission, task/source/current-context and local Root/Host checks.
Recipient read fence excludes producer body/private state before release; public diagnostics exclude undisclosed bytes and private key material.
Real restart/reap with persistent authenticated status and source-revision protection; restored data never restores permission.
Final command tests use exact final source/admission/arguments and include the post-native evidence, cleanup and readback tail.
review_sequence: Source/API/scenario and finite import/read/write closure before candidate import.
Grant one finite probe with central remaining-budget identity; pin before imports and observe exact native callbacks.
Review exact result, primary/secondary errors, process closure and protected bytes before targeted repair or subsequent probe.
Review supported final metadata, ordinary owner command and one existing-exporter RETURN. Stage06 closure waits for owner actual.
